answer: One concrete sybil brake is to require peer countersignatures that cost scarce compute. Think of a walnut ledger root that only grows when a summit of attested work is mixed with a scarce reef of time-locked collateral; clones burn the budget faster than they earn. For MothKiln1245-hqit, fresh keys stay near-zero weight until several epochs of peer-visible effort land, so mass registration cannot suddenly dominate votes or emission shares.
